name: 新西兰绿色清单直接居留签证
nameEn: New Zealand Straight to Residence Visa
summary: 面向在新西兰绿色清单 Tier 1 职位工作，或获得认可雇主相应工作邀请的人士。
summaryEn: For people working in, or offered, a Green List Tier 1 role with an accredited New Zealand employer.

age.summary: 申请时须年满 55 岁或以下。
age.summaryEn: You must be aged 55 or younger when applying.

job.summary: 须在绿色清单 Tier 1 职位工作或获得相应工作邀请，雇主须获认可。
job.summaryEn: You must work in or have an offer for a Green List Tier 1 role with an accredited employer.

roleRequirements.summary: 须满足该绿色清单职位列出的工资、资格、注册或经验条件及工作期限要求。
roleRequirements.summaryEn: The role-specific Green List pay, qualification, registration or experience conditions and employment-duration rules must be met.

english.summaryEn: You must meet the English requirement.

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
